training: Each seed uses only its nine common-first-collection episodes at origin zero from the frozen full-phase study. Both variants receive the same initial weights, normalization, optimizer, 900 sampled updates and batches. No later method-specific collection or diagnostic transition is fitted.
intervention: Replace only predicted root translation by old position plus dt/2 times old and predicted world linear velocity. Other state channels retain free residual predictions. Same parameter count; three direct position output channels are unused in the integrated arm. This approximates substep physics, not an exact simulator identity.
direction: Incoming zero-output actor and each seed's existing cycle-one common-data physical-return critic are frozen. Compute one full-parameter H32 model gradient on all nine training episode starts; normalize by RMS raw-logit response over that seed's entire common training collection. Check both signs at both fixed small amplitudes on three predeclared known reference families. No actor/seed/model selection or training claim.
evaluation: Score held-out noisy diagnostic episodes for H8/H32 state and root prediction. Evaluate deterministic physical prefix H32 and remaining full-reference discounted reward from origin zero for all parameter probes. Baseline evaluated once per selected clip and shared across seeds/variants. These are local direction diagnostics, not the unchanged 27-cell quality gate or unseen-reference tests.
